title: Moxi browser FDG
scenario: P01: actual Mojo App[GraphApp] through experimental Wasm64 retargeting. Capture provenance and source hashes are in captures.json.
host: Playwright headless Chrome; collaborative preview drag failed twice (see README)
backend: Mojo App[GraphApp] → Wasm64 → Moxi SVG + MoxiWebHost
fixture: sample_graph: 36 nodes; 100 real solver frames then Fit and Pause; working tree; see sourceDigest for experiment inputs; source SHA256 0a2767c1f10d3292a8237ddf57d91130887474558f8e172263fed2256b4aaf44

slides.caption: initial
slides.action: Load the page; both existing Moxi graph apps settle, fit and pause.
slides.expected: Both panes contain the 36-node Mojo graph and Moxi controls.

slides.caption: dragging
slides.action: Click node-0; ArrowRight selects node-1; drag node-0 by 80×45 CSS pixels and hold.
slides.expected: Node-0 follows the pointer and is pinned while held; instance B stays unchanged.

slides.caption: pan-zoom-resize
slides.action: Drag empty canvas left/up, wheel up 160 units, then click Resize A.
slides.expected: Moxi viewport and SVG resize to 720px; pan/zoom affect A only.

slides.caption: restart
slides.action: Use the Moxi Resume/Pause control twice, then Reheat. Animation is held for capture.
slides.expected: Reheat resets solver alpha and changes the Moxi control back to Pause.

slides.caption: two-instances
slides.action: Click the Moxi search field, type node-12, and press Enter.
slides.expected: Moxi text/key dispatch selects node-12; B retains its initial state.

slides.caption: disposed
slides.expected: A has no rendered graph or accessibility overlay; B remains live.

slides.caption: recreated
slides.action: Click Recreate A; attempt teardown with the old raw handle.
slides.expected: New independent state appears; stale handle returns invalid-handle without affecting it.

slides.caption: unsupported
slides.action: Load ?unsupported to force the unsupported feature path.
slides.expected: A clear memory64-required error appears; no JavaScript substitute graph.
